'''Barada''' was the third most popular baby name according to the [[HoloNet News/Legends|HoloNet News]] column, ''A Closer Look'', during the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].

Barada was usually given to [[Klatooinian/Legends|Klatooinian]] babies.
